FAQ.heading: Frequently asked questions
FAQ.q1Question: Which areas do you operate in?
FAQ.q1AnswerTemplate: {summary}. Our studio and workshop are located in Pardes Hana-Karkur, next to the cemetery.
FAQ.q2Question: Do you also handle approvals with the cemetery?
FAQ.q2Answer: Yes, our team accompanies you with the cemetery administration to coordinate measurements, approve the design, and set the installation date, so you don't have to deal with the bureaucracy during this difficult time.
FAQ.q3Question: Which stone types are recommended for Israel's weather conditions?
FAQ.q3Answer: Granite and quality marble are the common choice thanks to their resistance to heat, moisture, and direct sunlight over decades. We're happy to help choose the most suitable stone type and finish during the consultation meeting.
FAQ.q4Answer: Our warranty covers the stability of the installation and the quality of the stone and inscription over the years.
FAQ.q5Question: Can I order an additional inscription or update to an existing headstone?
FAQ.q5Answer: Absolutely. We engrave additional text, update dates, and touch up color on existing headstones, even ones we did not originally install.
FAQ.q6Answer: The price covers the stone, the design, production, and installation at the cemetery. The lettering (engraving the inscription) is not included and is quoted separately based on the amount of text.

ProcessSteps.heading: Our process
ProcessSteps.intro: At Alper Marble, we understand that every headstone is a whole life story. Our team accompanies you with sensitivity and dedication, from planning to final installation, while upholding a long-standing tradition of quality and craftsmanship.
ProcessSteps.step1Desc: Our team accompanies families personally, from planning to final installation, with attention to the smallest details.
ProcessSteps.step2Desc: Precise matching of the stone type, inscription, and artistic elements to the family's wishes and the memory of the deceased.
ProcessSteps.step3Desc: Meticulous handwork combining modern technology with a longstanding tradition of stone carving craftsmanship.
ProcessSteps.step4Desc: Professional, stable installation at cemeteries, with attention to a perfect finish and long-term durability.
